pages.text: Each level adds 20% durability and, on tools with mining speed, 5% mining speed. Existing Dragonsteel, Ghost Ingot and Dreadsteel material traits each gain levels equal to the Catalyst level. Missing traits are not granted.

Melee, ranged and projectile hits respond to the biome of the wielder. Deserts inflict Hunger and subject undead targets to sunlight burning; jungles and swamps inflict Poison I; cold biomes inflict Frost.
Oceans drain oxygen and deal one hit of drowning damage; the Nether inflicts Wither I; the End prevents teleportation. Biome effects with a duration last two seconds per level.
